aptu-coder

A Model Context Protocol (MCP) code-intelligence server that gives AI coding agents pre-parsed symbol tables instead of raw file bytes, cutting token usage by up to 59% in the cited benchmark conditions (see Benchmarks). OpenSSF silver certified: fewer than 1% of open source projects reach this level.

> [!NOTE] > Native agent tools (regex search, path matching, file reading) handle targeted lookups well. `aptu-coder` handles the mechanical, non-AI work: mapping directory structure and extracting symbols, so a coding agent's context window is spent reasoning instead of re-deriving structure on every call. Most code-intelligence tooling for AI agents indexes a codebase into a cloud embedding or vector store and retrieves by similarity search. aptu-coder instead parses the codebase on-device with tree-sitter and serves it locally over MCP: no source code leaves the machine, and retrieval is exact (symbol tables) rather than approximate (nearest-neighbor similarity). ## Benchmarks Paired comprehension tasks on Claude Code (MCP mode vs native shell search). Methodology: [Django](https://github.com/django/django) auth migration ([v12](https://github.com/clouatre-labs/aptu-coder/blob/main/docs/benchmarks/v12/methodology.md)) and [OpenFAST](https://github.com/OpenFAST/openfast) AeroDyn integration audit ([v13](https://github.com/clouatre-labs/aptu-coder/blob/main/docs/benchmarks/v13/methodology.md)). | Task | Mode | Sonnet 4.6 | Haiku 4.5 | Savings | |---|---|---|---|---| | Django (Python) | MCP | 112k tokens, $0.39 | 406k tokens, $0.42 | **59% fewer tokens, 59% cheaper** (Sonnet) | | Django (Python) | Native | 276k tokens, $0.95 | 473k tokens, $0.53 | 14% fewer tokens, 21% cheaper (Haiku) | | OpenFAST (Fortran) | MCP | 472k tokens, $1.65 | 687k tokens, $0.72 | **46% fewer tokens, 42% cheaper** (Sonnet) | | OpenFAST (Fortran) | Native | 877k tokens, $2.85 | 2162k tokens, $2.21 | **68% fewer tokens, 68% cheaper** (Haiku) | A real end-to-end multi-agent run against this repository itself: five refactoring issues (#1578–#1582) fixed by the [coder skill](https://github.com/clouatre-labs/agentic-coder-skill) in one orchestrated session — 23 subagent spawns (5 scout, 1 guard, 10 build, 7 check), ~1h42m, three human interventions — producing PRs #1584–#1588, all merged with CI green. [Case study](https://github.com/clouatre-labs/agentic-coder-skill/blob/main/docs/examples/2026-09-aptu-coder-5-issues.md). ### Scope of the benchmark claims The token-savings figures above come from single, focused comprehension tasks where the agent used aptu-coder instead of shell search. #### 1. **Repository Architecture**
The aptu-coder project is a Rust workspace with two crates:

- **aptu-coder**: MCP server wrapper and tool handlers

Language support follows a strict pattern: each language gets a module in `crates/aptu-coder-core/src/languages/` with tree-sitter queries and optional semantic handlers.

#### 2. **Language Integration Pattern**
Every new language requires:
1. **Module file** (`languages/php.rs`): Query constants and handler functions
2. **Wiring in mod.rs**: Registration in `get_language_info()` and `get_ts_language()` match arms
3. **Extension mapping** (`lang.rs`): File extension → language identifier
4. **Cargo dependency**: tree-sitter-php in workspace dependencies
5. **Test coverage**: 5-8 unit tests per language module

#### 3. **PHP Grammar Analysis**
tree-sitter-php 0.25.2 provides these declaration node types:
- `function_definition` (top-level functions)
- `method_declaration` (class/interface/trait methods)
- `class_declaration` (classes with `base_clause` for extends, `class_interface_clause` for implements)
- `interface_declaration` (interfaces, also support base_clause for parent interfaces)
- `trait_declaration` (traits)
- `enum_declaration` (PHP 8.1+ enums with `enum_case` children)
- `anonymous_function`, `arrow_function` (closures and arrow functions)
- `function_call_expression` (function calls)

**Inheritance Model:**
- **Extends:** `class_declaration` → `base_clause` → named children (name/qualified_name/relative_name)
- **Implements:** `class_declaration` → `class_interface_clause` → named children
- **Interface extends:** `interface_declaration` → `base_clause`
